## Summary

Describe the user-facing problem and the behavior this change introduces.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] Relevant contract or Electron E2E tests
- [ ] English and Chinese locale parity for user-visible text

## Architecture and attribution

- [ ] Agent behavior remains in pi or a pi extension
- [ ] Renderer integrations use the typed `hostInvoke` boundary
- [ ] Adapted or inspired code is identified in comments, NOTICE, and commit history
